subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When a review mapping or native-profile qualification is found defective after activation, the system shall engage FR-28 for new work, mark every affected in-flight or unaccepted pass and aggregate `rerun_required`, preserve unaffected work, rerun the complete FR-24/FR-26 pass set on the exact current revision, and for already accepted artifacts preserve shipped state while emitting an operator remediation brief naming each affected artifact.
rationale: defective capacity voids the evidence it produced but does not authorize destructive rollback
fit_criterion: a seeded defect invalidates every affected open process, reruns all required passes, leaves unaffected processes valid, and creates one complete brief for accepted artifacts without mutating them
